Marie is portrayed as a talented young musician whose primary motivation is to connect with her audience through genuine expression. Initially, she struggles with the external pressures of the music industry, which threaten to undermine her sense of self. However, her character undergoes significant development, evolving from a budding artist into a self-assured icon. In this final stage, she leverages her platform to advocate for artistic integrity, demonstrating a strengthened commitment to her authentic voice amidst the complexities of fame.
